description:
The April 2026 Pixel update is here! 📱

This Android 16 QPR3 patch may be small, but it brings important fixes—like banking app crashes, missing backup settings, Quick Share issues, and gaming stability improvements on newer devices.

We also cover Play Services updates, security tweaks, and a few Play Store changes you should know about.

👉 Is your Pixel running better after the update? Let us know in the comments!
